title: Awesome !
text: Awesome !. 2nd purchase .. i had one for a few years and it cracked (through no fault of the item itself)  and i had to replace my coffee pot so i replaced this too .. i love this thing  its really convenient !!  im sure it would fit any appliance as per the dimensions of it like a blender or toaster or whatever else but its great for the coffee pot .. i wish i had more room on my counter  i'd order 3 more of them for my other things

product_metadata.title: Handy Caddy Sliding Kitchen Under Cabinet Appliance Moving Caddy
description: Milen Handy Small Appliance Caddy; Black; 077-3075; New Our Handy caddy tray will ease all heavy burdens up to about 25 lbs.  Made to use on sturdy counter tops. With its easy sliding wheels, simply just pull out to extend the Handy Caddy, and with its easy to remove top, makes it efficient and easy to wash and is also dishwasher safe.
